Fertilization: Apply liquid fertilizers during April to May and September to November, except in summer and winter. Pruning: Remove dead and rotten part timely. Ideal temperature 8-35 C. Ideal humidity 15-80%. Ideal soil moisture 7-50. Ideal light 3000-70000 lux. Common problems: overwatering / root rot; underwatering; insufficient light; temperature stress; too much direct sun / leaf scorch; keeping soil too wet for a drought-tolerant species. Solutions: soil_too_dry: Water thoroughly until water drains, then empty the saucer. Avoid letting the root ball stay bone-dry for long. soil_too_wet: Hold off watering and improve drainage. Soggy soil risks root rot; check that the pot drains freely. temp_too_low: Move the plant away from cold drafts and windows. Keep within its preferred temperature range. temp_too_high: Reduce heat stress: move out of hot direct sun or away from heaters; increase airflow. humidity_too_low: Raise humidity with a tray of pebbles and water, grouping plants, or a humidifier. Avoid soaking fuzzy leaves if applicable. humidity_too_high: Increase airflow and avoid misting. Persistent high humidity can encourage fungal spots.
